description: Architecture & Landscape Design Plugin. Provides schema, 12-step workflow, artifact types, material/component contribution, overlay metadata, and preview-labelled outputs for architecture and landscape design projects. Does NOT provide BIM, GIS, CAD, structural calculation, or engineering engines.

routesToMount.note: Mount after packagingDesignRouter (if present). Router self-registers /ai/architecture-landscape/* (admin) and /public/architecture-landscape/* (public) prefixes.

schemaExportsRequested.note: Domain-local schema defines all three tables using pgSchema('ai_platform') locally. If Team 24 centralises schema, copy schema.ts into lib/db/src/schema/architecture-landscape.ts and add 'export * from "./architecture-landscape"' to index.ts.

integrationNotes: Admin routes (/ai/architecture-landscape/*) are protected by global adminAuthWithExceptions middleware — no per-route duplication needed.
Public routes (/public/architecture-landscape/*) do NOT require auth — client brief submission and project-ref status tracking only.
Migration draft at integration/migrations/team-29.sql — additive only, no DROP/TRUNCATE, all IF NOT EXISTS.
export_ready status gate: enforced in advanceWorkflowStep() — only reachable after all 12 steps complete in order.
Artifact honesty check enforced in addArtifact() — labels containing 'construction drawing', 'structural calculation', 'permit-ready drawing', or 'certified landscape plan' are rejected.
No BIM, GIS, CAD, structural calculation, or engineering engine is called anywhere in this plugin.
Component contribution uses upsert on component_code — safe to call repeatedly (idempotent).
Overlay metadata is built dynamically in addArtifact() and getOverlayMetadata() — no separate overlay table needed.
ARCHITECTURE_PREVIEW_DISCLAIMER must be included in any client-facing response that includes preview artifacts.

adapterDocumentation.note: Team 39 temporary adapter hooks below are per Rule 8 of the parallel execution rules.

adapters.name: ArchitectureLandscapePluginAdapter
adapters.purpose: Thin adapter for cross-plugin calls until Team 39 wires the event bus
adapters.location: No separate adapter file needed — getPluginManifest() and getOverlayMetadata() serve as the stable contract surface

invariants: export_ready status MUST NOT be set before all 12 workflow steps are completed in order
Artifact labels MUST NOT contain 'construction drawing', 'structural calculation', 'permit-ready drawing', or 'certified landscape plan'
architecture_plan_preview and architecture_elevation_preview artifact labels MUST include 'preview', 'draft', 'concept', or 'direction' language
No BIM, GIS, CAD, or structural calculation engine must be called from this plugin
All client-facing artifact responses MUST include ARCHITECTURE_PREVIEW_DISCLAIMER
